title: Encoded three-CNF satisfiability language
statement: Let an encoding assign canonical binary strings to encoded three-CNF formulas and decode binary strings, with failure indicated by no decoded formula. The language consists of precisely those binary strings that decode to an encoded three-CNF formula whose CNF formula is satisfiable; strings that fail to decode are excluded.
hypotheses_covered: A canonical binary encoding of encoded three-CNF formulas
